title: Rayuela: absolute message dates and a "since" filter
notes: `rayuela mensajes` returns `dateText` as shown in the list ("Jueves",
"Martes", "30 Oct"), so a refresh has to infer the date, and there is no
way to ask for messages after a known id. Next step: resolve the relative
text to an ISO date and add `--desde-id <X_IDENTIFICADOR>`.
result: Expose ISO dates and filter the first page of the chosen tray by an exact decimal message ID.
evidence: TZ=UTC pnpm exec vitest run src/rayuela src/cli/commands/rayuelaMensajes.test.ts src/cli/commands/rayuelaResponder.test.ts src/cli/rayuelaCommands.test.ts: 77 passing tests, including precise IDs, both trays, dates before and after Madrid midnight, and ambiguous dates left unset.
